description: Discard a launch waiting in your Agent Inbox, like its Discard button. Nothing is created in Meta. The saved build stays; use ads_delete_build to remove it as well. Launches that already started cannot be discarded. Use ads_edit_cancel for edit suggestions. Both preview detail levels report settings.launch (allowed, approval or off) separately from the edit mode; settings.approvalRuleAppliesTo is edits. Edit approval does not gate new-ad launches. Review mode returns reviewUrl and no executable plan. Share reviewUrl with the user, do not apply, and reuse reviewId on later previews in the same conversation. EDITS_REVIEW_REQUIRED means approval must happen in your Agent Inbox. Always preview and show the user the changes. Set a confirm flag only after the user explicitly approves that change. Never retry a partial apply blindly. Archive and delete cannot be undone. Preview requests accept optional reason and runTitle. A per-operation reason overrides the top-level reason for that operation. Use one short evidence-based note for the Agent Inbox and reuse runTitle with the same reviewId.

buildId.description: Saved build ID of the waiting launch, e.g. build_abc123...

name: ads_discard_launch
title: Discard a Waiting Launch
